goal: Prevent node crashes and shutdown hangs caused by background compaction exhausting disk space
Warn users and defer compaction when free disk space is less than the chainstate size
agreement: Approval after addressing comments on skipping compaction and warning details (stickies-v, optout21)
Suggested skipping compaction instead of only warning on low disk space (andrewtoth)

categories.name: validation
why: P1 because it fixes a regression where background compaction fills the disk and hangs node shutdown
Directly restores node reliability and crash safety for setups with tight disk margins
